## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->

I just ran an upgrade from `118.x` to `2021.1.5` - and the dreaded "record is taking > 10 seconds" problem happened, and it was stuck here for a LONG time (~10mins).
```
Jan 27 08:34:57 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:34:57 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.setup] Setup of recorder is taking over 10 seconds.
Jan 27 08:35:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:35:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder

Jan 27 08:40:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:40:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
Jan 27 08:41:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:41:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
Jan 27 08:42:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:42:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
Jan 27 08:43:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:43:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
Jan 27 08:44:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:44:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
Jan 27 08:45:46 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:45:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.bootstrap] Waiting on integrations to complete setup: recorder
```
during this time I could observe that hass disk I/O was active, but fairly slow ... like ~1-6MB/s ... I ran in a VM python venv, disks aren't that slow.

I started wondering / blaming / searching ... (recalled this issue from the past) ... was it #39980, #38904, #38897, #38810, #38452, #41760, ???

Just as I had finished digging through those issues, I checked back and noticed:
```
Jan 27 08:45:54 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:45:54 WARNING (Recorder) [homeassistant.components.recorder.migration] Database is about to upgrade. Schema version: 9
Jan 27 08:45:54 hass hass[16976]: 2021-01-27 08:45:54 WARNING (Recorder) [homeassistant.components.recorder.migration] Adding index `ix_states_old_state_id` to database. Note: this can take several minutes on large databases and slow computers. Please be patient!
```

Can we please print those log messages about the `schema` upgrade FIRST? - that way the admin/user knows to be patient :).


## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Configuration -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: `2021.1.5`
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): pre `114`?
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core):  `Ubuntu 16.04, python 3.8`
- Integration causing this issue:  `recorder`
- Link to integration documentation on our website:  N/A

-->
